virtual: Virtual chips only. No real money.
rulesText: No-limit Texas Hold’em. Bets are whole chips. The minimum raise equals the last full raise; a short all-in only reopens the action when it adds up to a full raise. The odd chip goes to the first winner left of the button. A player who runs out of time checks (if possible) or folds; two timeouts in a row sit the player out.
